nodes.description: DogeWorldToken.transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
DogeWorldToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; checks allowance, calls ensure, mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist check against owner, UNI pair and canSale, then requires condition().
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-gated delegatecall to an arbitrary user supplied address.
init(uint,uint,uint) public; owner-gated setter of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-gated loop that transfers tokens to many addresses.
setTradeAddress(address) public; owner-gated update of tradeAddress.
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; computes the Uniswap pair address from factory and tokens.
DogeWorldToken constructor(string,string,uint) payable; mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants infinite allowance to router UNI.
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spender approvals.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; per-address whitelist flag.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount.
uint256 private _saleNum; allowed number of sales per address.
address tradeAddress; whitelisted trading address.
address private owner; privileged account.
uint public totalSupply; total token supply.
uint constant public decimals = 18.
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...488D; Uniswap router constant.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate; executes arbitrary attacker-controlled bytecode in the token's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance decrement performed without SafeMath (Solidity 0.5 unchecked arithmetic).
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; multiplication can overflow without SafeMath.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value in batchSend without SafeMath.
token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init; unchecked scaling arithmetic.
require(msg.sender == owner) gate inside delegate; sole protection for an arbitrary delegatecall.
require(msg.sender == owner) gate inside init; controls sale parameters.
require(msg.sender == owner) gate inside batchSend; controls mass mint/transfer of balances.
msg.sender; used as caller identity, allowance owner and admin check throughout the contract.
